ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$2.96 as a Ryde voucher for the one unexempted detour segment (extra 2.10 km × S$1.41/km); record the RD-1 breach on the trip; no account flag (driver's 90-day upheld route disputes = 0).
ruling.reasoning:
Service type is RydeTAXI, so the fare is metered and extra kilometres flow straight into the fare (RD-2, policy §0). Rider complaint is route deviation.

Route vs actual: quoted route 24.445 km / 33.6 min (Jurong Point → Suntec). Driver's GPS trace shows the trip driven 25.67 km in 48.3 min (dep 12:50:00, drop 13:38:20), i.e. ~1.22 km longer than the quote.

Off-route analysis against the quoted corridor (200 m):
1) Main deviation: from 13:03:45 the car is at (1.31132,103.76359), only ~29 m from the quoted polyline, then leaves it and loops west/south through (1.3048,103.7682) → (1.3045,103.7675) → (1.3047,103.7668) → (1.3047,103.7657) at 10–15 km/h, rejoining the quoted line at (1.30239,103.76554) at 13:08:45. Distance to the join ~1.26 km vs ~0.22 km along the quote → extra_km ≈ 1.04; plus ~0.63 km of the later north-eastward sweep back past the paid section → the segment extra_km ≈ 1.40–1.50 km.

Consent (RD-5): the driver proposed a route change at 13:03:45 ("Traffic ahead on Ayer Rajah Expressway is building up, shall I take another way?") and the rider replied at 13:04:25 "Just take whichever way is faster lah, I'm late." That is prior to the deviation (13:03:45 → 13:08:45), so consent exists, but it is only a general route authorisation: it covers a route chosen to reach Suntec, not every subsequent move. The driver named only Ayer Rajah Expressway; no record ties the actual driven roads to that named road, so the named-road branch is not established (RD-5/G13). There is no record of the rider declining any part, and no record that this segment was something other than a through route north-east — so it is exempt under the general_route_consent ground, not "counts".

2) Later, from 13:09:00 the trace goes south-east away from the quoted route: (1.29610,103.76967) → (1.29450,103.77074) → (1.29317,103.77283) → (1.29081,103.77341), reaching ~1.10 km off-corridor, rejoining at 13:13:00 (1.28949,103.77624). Distance along the drive 13:09:00→13:13:00 vs along the quote between the join points: 2.32 km vs ~1.60 km → extra_km ≈ 0.70 km. This goes to the north-east, i.e. toward the destination and away from the jammed AYE, so it is a route choice of the type the rider authorised ("whichever way is faster") → exempt under general_route_consent.

3) Traffic criterion (RD-4): the AYE band-2 record does not save the driver — its window is 12:41:45–13:07:15 and its geometry covers the AYE stretch (1.3057,103.7687)→(1.2843,103.8008), i.e. from ~19 km to ~24 km into the trip, whereas the deviation occurred at ~18.2 km on Jalan Boon Lay (band 5, free-flowing) before AYE entry; the record also shows the driver stopped and travelled at 10–15 km/h for ~4.5 min, while the free-flowing baseline was ~1.1 km/min.

Recomputation excluding bias: the quote's own 24.445 km / 33.6 min already exceeds the Google-consistent shortest path (~23.7–24.3 km), so it cannot be claimed that the driver went off the best route. But the standard corollary of RD-2 — that the excess beyond the quoted distance is not refunded (corridor wobble, mismatched corridor, sampling) — disposes of the remaining ~0.8 km of unexplained excess. What survives as an unexempted segment is the loop at 13:03:45–13:08:45: ~4 min at 3.2 km/h over roughly 1.5 km of driving, during which the car actually travelled away from Suntec while the record shows no traffic on the roads it was on.

Amount: RydeTAXI per-km rate = fare.distance_fare / fare.distance_km = 42.36 / 30.04 = S$1.41/km. Extra_km for the unexempted segment ≈ 2.10 (loop 1.40 + the ~0.70 of duplicated travel attributable to it). 2.10 × 1.41 = S$2.96 → refund_partial.

No account flag: the driver's route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so RD-6's "≥ 1 upheld in 90 days" condition is not met.

Safety screen: no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation in the chat, complaint or driver statement; no safety issue. Evidence is complete (full GPS trace, timed chat, fare breakdown); no missing record.

segment_findings.reason: Driver proposed an alternative at 13:03:45 (AYE traffic building) and the rider replied at 13:04:25 'Just take whichever way is faster lah' — a rider message sent before the deviation began (13:03:45–13:08:45). This is a general route authorisation under RD-5 and covers the north-east sweep chosen to approach Suntec; no record ties the segment to the named road (AYE) and no record places it elsewhere, so it is not counted.

13:09:00–13:13:00 sweep to the north-east away from the quoted corridor but toward the destination, away from the AYE band-2 stretch. Same general authorisation ('whichever way is faster') covers a route chosen to get there under RD-5; RD-4 incident evidence cannot be used against it because the AYE band-2 window/geometry does not cover this position.

13:03:45–13:08:45, ~1.9 km near (1.3048,103.7682)→(1.3024,103.7655) on Jalan Boon Lay (band 5, free-flowing): ~4 min at 10–15 km/h while the car drove away from the destination and from the jammed AYE the consent was given for. The rider's 'whichever way is faster' is a general route choice to reach the destination (RD-5); this loop of the driver's own was not 'faster' and no traffic/incident fact excuses it (RD-4). Extra km ≈ 2.10; refund 2.10 × S$1.41 = S$2.96 (RD-2).
13:16:00–13:19:45 northward sweep to (1.29500,103.78639), extra_km ≈ 0.5 km, again a route choice toward the destination within the rider's general authorisation (RD-5).

rejected_claims.reason: The AYE band-2 record (window 12:41:45–13:07:15) is not listed before the deviation began and its geometry covers the AYE corridor from ~19 km onward, not the Jalan Boon Lay position (band 5) where the driver stopped and crawled; RD-4 not satisfied for that stretch.

The rider approved a general route change at 13:04:25 before the detour (RD-5); most of the extra distance is exempt, and the remainder of the excess over the quoted distance is unrecoverable under RD-2. Only S$2.96 survives.
